name: All infrastructure and cloud services MUST be securely configured to meet the CIS IG1 baseline/benchmark because this closes known security gaps that hackers actively exploit.
conditionsText: Configuration Management on platforms, cloud resource and servers
requirementTitle: All infrastructure and cloud services MUST be securely configured to meet the CIS IG1 baseline/benchmark because this closes known security gaps that hackers actively exploit.
requirementDescription: All servers, cloud resources, platforms, and services must be configured according to the CIS IG1 security baseline so they are protected against common and well-known attacks.
why:
Most successful attacks don't rely on sophisticated hacking.
Instead, attackers often exploit:
- Default settings
- Excessive permissions
- Open ports
- Missing encryption
- Poor configurations

actions.title: All infrastructure and cloud services MUST be securely configured to meet the CIS IG1 baseline/benchmark because this closes known security
actions.description: Teams should build against the approved standard. Don't rely on vendor defaults. Configure every server, cloud resource, and platform according to recognised security standards (CIS IG1) and continuously check that those settings remain in place.
